toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search the small SVV public knowledge facade. Use this when you need the right current SVV context document before fetching it.

toolsPreview.name: agent_query
toolsPreview.description: Ask SVV a bounded public question. Supported intents: capabilities, merchant_policy, merchant_trust and product_search. This tool never orders, negotiates, contacts people, takes payment or changes store data.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one canonical SVV context document from the public facade. Use after search() when you need the actual text.

toolsPreview.name: latest_memory_snapshot
toolsPreview.description: Return the current canonical SVV snapshot. Use this for a fast overview instead of calling many separate tools.

toolsPreview.name: ops_status_summary
toolsPreview.description: Return a compact operational status summary plus minimal startup/readback snapshot. Use this as the one-call fallback when ChatGPT tool invocation is flaky.

toolsPreview.name: startup_operator_snapshot
toolsPreview.description: Return the one-call ChatGPT/Codex startup snapshot with workability cards, routes and current P0 focus.

toolsPreview.name: public_facade_self_check
toolsPreview.description: Return the facade tool manifest and deployment metadata.
